flags.issue: Listed as 'drive-in staging', but Graves Creek Road was closed to vehicles at mile 4.1 (erosion) as of May 2026 per WTA trip report 2026-05-03 / NPS Olympic news releases; South Shore Road also closed, access via North Shore Road only. Currently walk/bike-in; re-check NPS status before relying on it.

wa_andersons_thumb_standard.why: Anderson's Thumb is climbed from Anderson Pass via the West Fork Dosewallips (or East Fork Quinault/Enchanted Valley). The Elwha valley camps, Elwha/Queets Basin, Low Divide and Dodger Point all belong to the upper Elwha / North Fork Quinault / Bailey Range corridor ~15-20 km NW; no way in to Anderson Pass passes them. Zone list propagated across the whole interior Olympics.

wa_mount_clark_standard.why: Cameron Basin and Dose Meadows are the bases for Mount Cameron / Mount Claywood, reached from Obstruction Point (Grand Pass/Lost Pass) or the Dosewallips road — ~10-13 km west/southwest. This route uses the Upper Dungeness / Maynard Burn trailheads (Royal Basin, Home Lake, Maynard Burn); none of its ways in reach either camp. | Cedar Lake is reached up the upper Gray Wolf River from the Gray Wolf/Slab Camp trailhead on the WEST flank of the Needles (WTA/ProTrails Upper Gray Wolf); its own note says it serves only the Gray Wolf Ridge crest and the north end of the Needles at Walkinshaw. This route approaches from Royal Basin / Home Lake on the east/south side.

wa_mount_claywood_standard.why: Claywood is climbed from Dose Meadows/Lost Pass (Obstruction Point or Dosewallips). Royal Basin, Camp Handy and Boulder Shelter are Upper Dungeness trail camps for the Needles/Constance group. | Home Lake (below Constance Pass) is on the Dungeness side; the Constance Pass trail joins the Dosewallips at Sunnybrook, down-valley of Dose Meadows, so it is not on Claywood's Lost Pass approach.

wa_the_triad_east_peak.why: The Triad (48.52,-121.16) is approached from the Hidden Lake Trailhead on FR-1540 (Sibley Creek Road, ~10 mi up Cascade River Road) via Sibley Creek Pass and the Triad Glacier (own prose; SummitPost Hidden Lake Peaks; Wikipedia The Triad). Every listed camp is at the Boston Basin / Cascade Pass road end ~8 km east, beyond Johannesburg. Pelton Basin's note claiming a 'Middle Cascade Glacier approach to The Triad' is itself wrong: the Middle Cascade Glacier is south of Mixup, nowhere near The Triad.
